subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Four-Stroke Cycle
description: A quick win: understand The Four-Stroke Cycle.

hook.text: Every gasoline engine repeats the same four steps thousands of times per minute.

buildup.text: First, the piston pulls down and sucks in air and fuel. That's the intake stroke.

discovery.text: Then it compresses the mixture, a spark ignites it, and the explosion pushes the piston down—that's power.

twist.text: The final stroke pushes burnt gases out. The whole cycle takes a fraction of a second.

climax.text: At 3,000 RPM, each cylinder fires 25 times per second. Multiply that by four or six cylinders.

punchline.text: Suck, squeeze, bang, blow—on repeat forever.

quiz.question: What are the four strokes in order?
